seam_ownership_refusal.SEAM_SWAP_MOVES_L.fix: Ask the platform team to make the setting sticky to its slot.

seam_ownership_check.SEAM_OWNERSHIP_NOT_.what: The deploy could not read the target's settings to check who owns them.
seam_ownership_check.SEAM_OWNERSHIP_NOT_.why: Unknown ownership is not clear ownership; refused.
seam_ownership_check.SEAM_OWNERSHIP_NOT_.fix: Check the deploy identity can read app settings, and that KIT_SETTING_KEYS is a list of names; re-run.

release_record.RELEASE_RECORD_NOT_KEPT.what: The deploy could not save its durable release record.
release_record.RELEASE_RECORD_NOT_KEPT.why: Without it, the release cannot be audited later; the step fails.
release_record.RELEASE_RECORD_NOT_KEPT.fix: Check the deploy job grants deployments: write (lease off) or that the lease store is reachable (lease on); re-run.

edge_purge.EDGE_PURGE_REFUSED.what: The edge endpoint the environment names is not a Front Door endpoint, so its cache was not cleared.
edge_purge.EDGE_PURGE_REFUSED.why: Users may see the old version until the cache expires.
edge_purge.EDGE_PURGE_REFUSED.fix: Ask the platform team to correct KIT_EDGE_ENDPOINT.

edge_purge.EDGE_PURGE_FAILED.what: Clearing the edge cache failed after a good release.
edge_purge.EDGE_PURGE_FAILED.why: Users may see the old version until the cache expires; the release itself stands.
edge_purge.EDGE_PURGE_FAILED.fix: Purge the endpoint by hand or wait for the cache to expire; check the deploy identity's rights on Front Door.

tier_source.TIER_SELF_DECLARED.what: The environment's tier (dev, test, uat, prod) was set by the team, not by the landing zone.
tier_source.TIER_SELF_DECLARED.why: The tier decides how strict the deploy is; a self-declared tier is recorded so reviewers can see it.
tier_source.TIER_SELF_DECLARED.fix: Inside a landing zone, ask the platform team to vend KIT_ENVIRONMENT_TIER.

tier_reality.TIER_MISMATCH_SUSPECTED.what: An environment marked dev or test looks like production (a custom domain, or production-like scale).
tier_reality.TIER_MISMATCH_SUSPECTED.why: Production traffic may be getting dev-level checks.
tier_reality.TIER_MISMATCH_SUSPECTED.fix: Check KIT_ENVIRONMENT_TIER for this environment; if it serves real users, mark it uat or prod.

tier_reality.TIER_REALITY_UNREAD.what: The deploy could not read whether the target looks like production.
tier_reality.TIER_REALITY_UNREAD.why: A missing signal, recorded so a reviewer knows.
tier_reality.TIER_REALITY_UNREAD.fix: Nothing usually; it follows an earlier refusal in the same run.

kit_watermark.WATERMARK_DIRTY.what: The kit copy you call was exported from uncommitted changes.
kit_watermark.WATERMARK_DIRTY.why: Nobody can say exactly which kit code ran.
kit_watermark.WATERMARK_DIRTY.fix: Ask the platform team to re-export the kit from a clean commit and repin.

kit_watermark.WATERMARK_UNREADABLE.what: The kit copy you call has a damaged version marker.
kit_watermark.WATERMARK_UNREADABLE.why: Nobody can tie the pinned SHA to the kit source.
kit_watermark.WATERMARK_UNREADABLE.fix: Ask the platform team to re-export the kit.

evidence_retention.EVIDENCE_RETENTION_RA.what: KIT_EVIDENCE_RETENTION_DAYS was below the audit minimum (or not a number), so the minimum was used.
evidence_retention.EVIDENCE_RETENTION_RA.why: Evidence must be kept long enough for audit.
evidence_retention.EVIDENCE_RETENTION_RA.fix: Set KIT_EVIDENCE_RETENTION_DAYS to at least the floor (90 by default), or remove it.

evidence_retention.EVIDENCE_RETENTION_CA.what: KIT_EVIDENCE_RETENTION_DAYS was above GitHub's 400-day maximum, so 400 was used.

rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_REFU.what: A rollback sequence was requested with an end-to-end test period of 0.
rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_REFU.why: Each step must be tested over a real period before the next; nothing was touched.
rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_REFU.fix: Set the e2e test period (1-240 minutes) and re-run.

rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_REFU.what: A rollback sequence was requested without an end-to-end test command.
rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_REFU.why: Untested reversals can break the user path; nothing was touched.
rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_REFU.fix: Pass e2e_test_command (or set KIT_E2E_TEST_COMMAND) and re-run.

rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_REFU.what: The rollback sequence or a step's deploy evidence could not be read, or did not fit together.
rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_REFU.fix: Check the run ids in the sequence (the summary names the bad one) and re-run.

rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_STOP.what: The sequence stopped before a step that is not safe to roll back.
rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_STOP.why: Earlier steps are rolled back and verified; that step and later ones are untouched.
rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_STOP.fix: Ask the platform team to decide on the ineligible step (the summary names it).

rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_HALT.what: A step's rollback did not complete cleanly, so the sequence stopped.
rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_HALT.why: A partial rollback is never treated as done.
rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_HALT.fix: Contact the platform team with the run link.

rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_HALT.what: After a step was rolled back, the app's health check failed, so the sequence stopped.
rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_HALT.why: Rolling back further could make it worse.
rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_HALT.fix: Contact the platform team with the run link.

rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_HALT.what: After a step was rolled back, the end-to-end tests failed, so the sequence stopped.
rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_HALT.why: A person decides the next step.
rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_HALT.fix: Contact the platform team with the run link and the failing test.

rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_STOP.what: A step's resources were changed by someone else since the release, so a full rollback was refused.
rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_STOP.why: Undoing them would overwrite another team's change.
rollback_sequence.ROLLBACK_SEQUENCE_STOP.fix: Ask the platform team to resolve the conflict the summary names.

rollback_sequence_step.ROLLBACK_STEP_HAL.what: This rollback step ran and did not hold (rollback, health or tests).
rollback_sequence_step.ROLLBACK_STEP_HAL.fix: Contact the platform team with the run link.

rollback_sequence_step.ROLLBACK_STEP_INE.what: This step was judged unsafe to roll back and was not touched.
rollback_sequence_step.ROLLBACK_STEP_INE.fix: Contact the platform team with the run link.

rollback_sequence_step.ROLLBACK_STEP_PAR.what: Only the parts of this step that nobody else changed were rolled back.
rollback_sequence_step.ROLLBACK_STEP_PAR.why: The rest is left for a person.
rollback_sequence_step.ROLLBACK_STEP_PAR.fix: Ask the platform team to review the remaining items.

rollback_dependency_outcome.ROLLBACK_PAR.what: Someone else changed part of what this release changed, so only the independent parts were rolled back.
rollback_dependency_outcome.ROLLBACK_PAR.why: The rest is left as it is, each with its reason.
rollback_dependency_outcome.ROLLBACK_PAR.fix: Ask the platform team to review the remaining items.

rollback_dependency_outcome.ROLLBACK_REF.what: Everything this release changed was also changed by someone else, so nothing was rolled back.
rollback_dependency_outcome.ROLLBACK_REF.why: Undoing it would overwrite another change.
rollback_dependency_outcome.ROLLBACK_REF.fix: Ask the platform team to decide.

rollback_dependency_outcome.ROLLBACK_REF.what: The rollback would change a resource the landing zone owns (DNS, Front Door, network rules).
rollback_dependency_outcome.ROLLBACK_REF.why: The kit never reverts platform resources.
rollback_dependency_outcome.ROLLBACK_REF.fix: Ask the platform team; they own that change.

rollback_dependency_outcome.ROLLBACK_REF.what: The evidence for a rollback step is not from a kit deploy of this target.
rollback_dependency_outcome.ROLLBACK_REF.why: The kit only rolls back its own releases.
rollback_dependency_outcome.ROLLBACK_REF.fix: Check the run id in the sequence names a kit deploy of this target.

ticketing_availability.TICKETING_TEST_TA.what: A test ticketing run (from a branch other than main) was pointed at a real Jira project, so nothing was sent.
ticketing_availability.TICKETING_TEST_TA.why: Test runs must never create tickets in real projects.
ticketing_availability.TICKETING_TEST_TA.fix: Point the sandbox environment's JIRA_PROJECT at a test project, or run from main.

ticketing_availability.TICKETING_UNAVAIL.what: The ticket tracker could not be reached, refused the credentials, or a write failed.
ticketing_availability.TICKETING_UNAVAIL.why: Tickets owed this run are carried forward; nothing is concluded from what was not read.
ticketing_availability.TICKETING_UNAVAIL.fix: Check JIRA_EMAIL, JIRA_TOKEN and JIRA_HOST in the ticketing environment (a token may have expired), then re-run.

ticketing_availability.TICKETING_NOT_CON.what: No ticket tracker is configured (or two are), so no tickets were created or checked.
ticketing_availability.TICKETING_NOT_CON.why: Findings that need tickets did not get them.
ticketing_availability.TICKETING_NOT_CON.fix: Set the tracker secrets in the ticketing environment (docs/adoption/SETUP.md, ticketing) and the backend input to jira.

ticket_lookup_outcome.BINDING_AMBIGUOUS.what: More than one ticket claims the same finding, so the kit updated none of them.
ticket_lookup_outcome.BINDING_AMBIGUOUS.why: Picking one would be a guess.
ticket_lookup_outcome.BINDING_AMBIGUOUS.fix: Close the duplicate tickets (each is named in the summary) so one remains.

ticket_lookup_outcome.BINDING_DANGLING.what: A ticket the kit recorded for a finding could not be found (deleted, moved or no access).
ticket_lookup_outcome.BINDING_DANGLING.why: A missing ticket is not proof the work is done; nothing new was created.
ticket_lookup_outcome.BINDING_DANGLING.fix: Restore or re-link the ticket, or check the credential can see that project.

ticket_lookup_outcome.BINDING_UNESTABLIS.what: The ticket search did not finish (rate limit, outage or expired credential).
ticket_lookup_outcome.BINDING_UNESTABLIS.why: Without a complete search the kit cannot tell whether a ticket exists, so it creates none.
ticket_lookup_outcome.BINDING_UNESTABLIS.fix: Re-run later; check the tracker credential if it repeats.

ticket_lookup_outcome.IDENTITY_NOT_ESTAB.what: A finding has no stable identity, so no ticket can be looked up or created for it.
ticket_lookup_outcome.IDENTITY_NOT_ESTAB.why: A ticket on an unstable identity would be duplicated every run.
ticket_lookup_outcome.IDENTITY_NOT_ESTAB.fix: Nothing for you; the summary lists the finding for a person to triage.

ticket_reference_outcome.NO_CANDIDATE_PA.what: The pull request mentions a ticket, but its number is outside the allowed range.
ticket_reference_outcome.NO_CANDIDATE_PA.why: The check accepts only references that look like your tracker's real keys.
ticket_reference_outcome.NO_CANDIDATE_PA.fix: Edit the pull request description to use the full ticket key (for example PROJ-1234).

ticket_reference_outcome.NO_CANDIDATE.what: The pull request description does not mention a ticket.
ticket_reference_outcome.NO_CANDIDATE.why: Every change must link to its work item.
ticket_reference_outcome.NO_CANDIDATE.fix: Add the ticket key (for example PROJ-1234) to the pull request description.

ticket_reference_outcome.NO_TEXT.what: The pull request description is empty.
ticket_reference_outcome.NO_TEXT.why: There was nothing to search for a ticket key.
ticket_reference_outcome.NO_TEXT.fix: Write a description that includes the ticket key.

ticket_reference_outcome.POLICY_MISCONFI.what: The ticket-number range in the workflow is set up wrongly (one bound missing, not a number, or reversed).
ticket_reference_outcome.POLICY_MISCONFI.why: The check could not run; this is a platform setting, not your pull request.
ticket_reference_outcome.POLICY_MISCONFI.fix: Ask the workflow owner to fix the min/max digit inputs of the ticket-reference job.

ticket_reference_outcome.NOT_A_PULL_REQU.what: The ticket-reference check ran on something that is not a pull request, so it checked nothing.
ticket_reference_outcome.NOT_A_PULL_REQU.fix: Nothing; it only applies to pull requests.

ticket_intake_state.TRACKER_INTAKE_PARTI.what: The search of existing tickets did not finish.
ticket_intake_state.TRACKER_INTAKE_PARTI.why: Tickets not read are not absent; new tickets are created in triage to be checked again.
ticket_intake_state.TRACKER_INTAKE_PARTI.fix: Re-run later; check the tracker credential if it repeats.

ticket_intake_state.TRACKER_INTAKE_NOT_C.what: The kit cannot search this tracker for existing tickets.
ticket_intake_state.TRACKER_INTAKE_NOT_C.why: Duplicates cannot be found before creating.
ticket_intake_state.TRACKER_INTAKE_NOT_C.fix: Use Jira for work tickets (the kit's supported tracker).

ticket_intake_state.TRACKER_QUERY_REFUSE.what: A ticket search named a project outside this repository's projects, or used a forbidden query clause.
ticket_intake_state.TRACKER_QUERY_REFUSE.why: Searches are limited to this repository's projects.
ticket_intake_state.TRACKER_QUERY_REFUSE.fix: Search only this repository's ticket projects, without ORDER BY.

review_finalize_state.REVIEW_NOT_FINALIZ.what: The security review behind these tickets is not finalized with a recorded approval by a second person.
review_finalize_state.REVIEW_NOT_FINALIZ.why: Tickets are written only from a finalized, approved review; nothing was read or written.
review_finalize_state.REVIEW_NOT_FINALIZ.fix: Have the concurring reviewer approve the review record's pull request and merge it; the summary lists each missing rule.

ticket_template_refusal.TEMPLATE_UNKNOWN.what: The ticket template named is not one the kit serves.
ticket_template_refusal.TEMPLATE_UNKNOWN.fix: Use a template listed in docs/ticketing/TICKET-TYPES.md.

ticket_template_refusal.TEMPLATE_VERSION.what: The ticket template version is not supported (version 2 is current).

ticket_template_refusal.TEMPLATE_FIELD_I.what: A ticket item breaks its template (a missing field, a bad value, or an expiry in the past).
ticket_template_refusal.TEMPLATE_FIELD_I.why: Only complete, valid items are written.
ticket_template_refusal.TEMPLATE_FIELD_I.fix: Correct the field the refusal names.

ticket_template_refusal.TEMPLATE_ASSET_I.what: The asset named in a ticket item is not a valid identity (wrong subscription, account or a missing field).
ticket_template_refusal.TEMPLATE_ASSET_I.why: Tickets must point at a real, owned asset.
ticket_template_refusal.TEMPLATE_ASSET_I.fix: Correct the asset id the refusal names.

ticket_template_refusal.NOFIX_EXEMPTION_.what: A no-fix re-check asked for an automatic exemption longer than allowed.
ticket_template_refusal.NOFIX_EXEMPTION_.why: Longer exemptions need a person to accept the risk.
ticket_template_refusal.NOFIX_EXEMPTION_.fix: Shorten the exemption, or request an accepted risk.

ticket_template_refusal.LINK_DECISION_IN.what: A link decision names a finding, ticket or candidate that does not exist in the request.
ticket_template_refusal.LINK_DECISION_IN.why: Links must point at real candidates.
ticket_template_refusal.LINK_DECISION_IN.fix: Link only tickets the search returned.

ticket_template_refusal.TICKET_NOT_KIT_L.what: An extension or closure names a ticket the kit does not own or link.
ticket_template_refusal.TICKET_NOT_KIT_L.why: The kit changes only its own tickets.
ticket_template_refusal.TICKET_NOT_KIT_L.fix: Update that ticket in the tracker directly.

ticket_template_refusal.EXTENSION_COUNT_.what: The number of extensions claimed differs from what the ticket's labels show.
ticket_template_refusal.EXTENSION_COUNT_.fix: Use the count the ticket shows.

ticket_template_refusal.EXTENSION_LIMIT_.what: The ticket has had the maximum number of extensions.
ticket_template_refusal.EXTENSION_LIMIT_.fix: Fix the finding, or ask the owner for an accepted-risk decision.

ticket_template_refusal.EXTENSION_CEILIN.what: The requested new expiry is further out than one extension allows.
ticket_template_refusal.EXTENSION_CEILIN.fix: Request an expiry within the ceiling.

ticket_template_refusal.CLOSURE_NOT_VERI.what: A closure was requested but the kit's scan does not show the finding fixed.
ticket_template_refusal.CLOSURE_NOT_VERI.why: Tickets close only on verified fixes.
ticket_template_refusal.CLOSURE_NOT_VERI.fix: Merge the fix to the mapped branch and let the scan run, then close.

ticket_template_refusal.SOD_SELF_APPROVA.what: The person approving is the author of what is being approved.
ticket_template_refusal.SOD_SELF_APPROVA.why: Nobody approves their own exception, triage or fix.
ticket_template_refusal.SOD_SELF_APPROVA.fix: Have another approver from the list approve it.

ticket_template_refusal.EXCEPTION_TOO_LO.what: An exception asked for longer than the maximum (90 days).

ticket_template_refusal.TEMPLATE_NOT_ENA.what: The template is proposed and not enabled yet.
ticket_template_refusal.TEMPLATE_NOT_ENA.fix: Use an enabled template, or ask the owner to enable it.

ticket_template_outcome.TEMPLATE_DEDUPE_.what: The duplicate search did not finish, so the ticket was created in triage marked dedupe-pending.
ticket_template_outcome.TEMPLATE_DEDUPE_.why: It is never lost; the next run checks it again.
ticket_template_outcome.TEMPLATE_DEDUPE_.fix: Nothing; a person triages it if the next run still cannot.

ticket_template_outcome.TEMPLATE_OUTBOX.what: The tracker could not be written, so the item was kept in the outbox for the next run.
ticket_template_outcome.TEMPLATE_OUTBOX.why: Nothing is lost; a person was alerted.
ticket_template_outcome.TEMPLATE_OUTBOX.fix: Check the tracker credential; the next run retries first.

ticket_template_outcome.TEMPLATE_SENT_BA.what: The concurring reviewer disagreed with this item, so nothing was written for it.
ticket_template_outcome.TEMPLATE_SENT_BA.fix: Discuss with the reviewer and resubmit if agreed.

ticket_template_outcome.TEMPLATE_VERIFIC.what: A verifier rejected the fix, so the ticket was reopened.
ticket_template_outcome.TEMPLATE_VERIFIC.fix: Read the verifier's reason on the ticket and fix again.

code_finding_key_state.SECRET_FINGERPRIN.what: A secret finding's location could not be read, so it has no ticket key yet.
code_finding_key_state.SECRET_FINGERPRIN.why: It still blocks; it is ticketed once it can be read.
code_finding_key_state.SECRET_FINGERPRIN.fix: Make sure the checkout is the scanned commit (the default template does); re-run.

code_finding_key_state.RULE_FAMILY_UNKNO.what: A scanner rule is not in the kit's rule-family table, so its finding has no ticket key.
code_finding_key_state.RULE_FAMILY_UNKNO.why: The kit never guesses a family; the rule is routed to a person to map.
code_finding_key_state.RULE_FAMILY_UNKNO.fix: Nothing for you; the platform team adds the alias (the refusal names the tool and rule).

code_finding_key_state.SOURCE_NOT_AVAILA.what: The file a finding names is not in the checkout, so its code anchor could not be read.
code_finding_key_state.SOURCE_NOT_AVAILA.why: The finding stands; only its location anchor is missing.
code_finding_key_state.SOURCE_NOT_AVAILA.fix: Nothing usually; check the scanned path exists in the repository.

code_finding_key_state.SOURCE_PATH_REFUS.what: A finding names a path outside the repository, so the kit refused to read it.
code_finding_key_state.SOURCE_PATH_REFUS.why: A scanner's path is data and never reaches outside the scanned tree.
code_finding_key_state.SOURCE_PATH_REFUS.fix: Report the scanner and rule to the platform team.

code_finding_key_state.SOURCE_LINE_OUT_O.what: A finding names a line past the end of the file, so the checkout is not the scanned commit.
code_finding_key_state.SOURCE_LINE_OUT_O.why: No anchor is taken from another commit's text.
code_finding_key_state.SOURCE_LINE_OUT_O.fix: Re-run on the same commit the scan ran on.

code_finding_key_state.SOURCE_LINE_EMPTY.what: A finding points at a blank or comment line, so it anchors nothing.
code_finding_key_state.SOURCE_LINE_EMPTY.why: An empty line cannot identify code.
code_finding_key_state.SOURCE_LINE_EMPTY.fix: Nothing; the finding keeps its other identity.

exception_resurfacing.EXCEPTION_DUE_SOON.what: An exception expires within the next 14 days.
exception_resurfacing.EXCEPTION_DUE_SOON.why: When it lapses, the finding blocks or routes again.
exception_resurfacing.EXCEPTION_DUE_SOON.fix: Fix the finding, or ask the approver about renewal before the date.

exception_resurfacing.EXCEPTION_OVERDUE.what: An exception has expired, or its expiry date cannot be read.
exception_resurfacing.EXCEPTION_OVERDUE.why: An unreadable date has not "not arrived"; the finding is treated normally.
exception_resurfacing.EXCEPTION_OVERDUE.fix: Fix the finding, or get a new dated approval.

exception_resurfacing.EXCEPTIONS_DUE.what: At least one exception is due or overdue.
exception_resurfacing.EXCEPTIONS_DUE.why: Each is listed with its ticket.
exception_resurfacing.EXCEPTIONS_DUE.fix: Work through the list in the run summary.

exception_resurfacing.NOT_ATTEMPTED.what: Resurfacing was asked for but not attempted because a source could not be read.
exception_resurfacing.NOT_ATTEMPTED.why: Nothing was raised on any ticket.
exception_resurfacing.NOT_ATTEMPTED.fix: Check the register files are readable and re-run.

exception_resurfacing.NOT_CONFIGURED.what: No Jira credential is configured, so due exceptions were listed but not raised on tickets.
exception_resurfacing.NOT_CONFIGURED.why: The list is still accurate; only the ticket comments are missing.
exception_resurfacing.NOT_CONFIGURED.fix: Set JIRA_EMAIL, JIRA_TOKEN and JIRA_HOST in the ticketing environment.

exception_resurfacing.RESURFACE_FAILED.what: Raising a due exception on its ticket failed.
exception_resurfacing.RESURFACE_FAILED.why: The ticket owner may not see it is due.
exception_resurfacing.RESURFACE_FAILED.fix: Check the Jira credential and that the tracker is Jira; re-run.

exception_resurfacing.EXCEPTION_TICKET_M.what: An exception's Jira ticket does not exist or does not match the register (approver or renewal).
exception_resurfacing.EXCEPTION_TICKET_M.why: Reported, never blocking: the register decides; the ticket should agree.
exception_resurfacing.EXCEPTION_TICKET_M.fix: Correct the ticket (approver, renewal comment) to match the register.

kit_api_state.API_NOT_FOUND.what: No run for this API call has appeared yet.
kit_api_state.API_NOT_FOUND.why: A dispatch can take seconds to appear; not found is not refused.
kit_api_state.API_NOT_FOUND.fix: Wait a few seconds and check the status again (status.get).

kit_api_state.API_AWAITING_APPROVAL.what: The API call is waiting for a person to approve a release in its environment.
kit_api_state.API_AWAITING_APPROVAL.why: The API never approves anything itself.
kit_api_state.API_AWAITING_APPROVAL.fix: A reviewer approves it in the run page (Review deployments).

kit_api_state.API_REFUSED.what: The API call was refused by name before anything was done.
kit_api_state.API_REFUSED.why: The refusal (an API_ code) says exactly why.
kit_api_state.API_REFUSED.fix: Read the refusal code; each has its own entry in this catalogue.

kit_api_state.API_FAILED.what: The API call was accepted but could not be carried out.
kit_api_state.API_FAILED.fix: Read the result's reason (tracker unreachable, a release that did not report) and retry with the same idempotency key.

kit_api_state.API_CANCELLED.what: The API run was cancelled before it answered.
kit_api_state.API_CANCELLED.why: Nothing is known about the outcome.
kit_api_state.API_CANCELLED.fix: Resubmit with the same idempotency key.

kit_api_state.API_RESULT_UNREADABLE.what: The API run finished, but no valid result for this call could be read.
kit_api_state.API_RESULT_UNREADABLE.why: A finished run is not a finished call.
kit_api_state.API_RESULT_UNREADABLE.fix: Read the run's log and summary; retry with the same idempotency key.

kit_api_refusal.API_HOST_NOT_NAMED.what: The API client was not told which GitHub host to call.
kit_api_refusal.API_HOST_NOT_NAMED.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.

kit_api_refusal.API_HOST_INSECURE.what: The API address is not https.
kit_api_refusal.API_HOST_INSECURE.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.

kit_api_refusal.API_CREDENTIAL_ABSENT.what: The API client has no token.
kit_api_refusal.API_CREDENTIAL_ABSENT.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.
kit_api_refusal.API_CREDENTIAL_ABSENT.fix: Set GH_TOKEN (or KIT_API_TOKEN), or KIT_API_AUTH=proxy behind a credential proxy.

kit_api_refusal.API_REQUEST_UNPARSEABLE.what: The API request is not a JSON object.
kit_api_refusal.API_REQUEST_UNPARSEABLE.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.

kit_api_refusal.API_REQUEST_TOO_LARGE.what: The API request is over 60,000 characters.
kit_api_refusal.API_REQUEST_TOO_LARGE.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.
kit_api_refusal.API_REQUEST_TOO_LARGE.fix: Select fewer findings or page the search.

kit_api_refusal.API_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.what: The API request names a version the kit does not serve.
kit_api_refusal.API_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.

kit_api_refusal.API_OPERATION_UNKNOWN.what: The API request names an operation that does not exist.
kit_api_refusal.API_OPERATION_UNKNOWN.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.
kit_api_refusal.API_OPERATION_UNKNOWN.fix: Use an operation listed in docs/api/README.md.

kit_api_refusal.API_OPERATION_NOT_ENABLE.what: This repository has not turned on the requested API operation.
kit_api_refusal.API_OPERATION_NOT_ENABLE.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.
kit_api_refusal.API_OPERATION_NOT_ENABLE.fix: The repository owner adds it to vars.KIT_API_OPERATIONS, or call another repository.

kit_api_refusal.API_SCHEMA_VIOLATION.what: A field in the API request is invalid.
kit_api_refusal.API_SCHEMA_VIOLATION.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.
kit_api_refusal.API_SCHEMA_VIOLATION.fix: Correct the field the refusal names.

kit_api_refusal.API_CORRELATION_MISMATCH.what: The correlation id in the dispatch and in the request differ.
kit_api_refusal.API_CORRELATION_MISMATCH.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.
kit_api_refusal.API_CORRELATION_MISMATCH.fix: Send the same id in both; let scripts/kit_api.py make it.

kit_api_refusal.API_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQU.what: A write request came without an idempotency key (or with two different ones).
kit_api_refusal.API_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQU.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.
kit_api_refusal.API_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQU.fix: Send one key per intended write, the same in both places.

kit_api_refusal.API_DUPLICATE_REQUEST.what: This idempotency key was already used; nothing was done again.
kit_api_refusal.API_DUPLICATE_REQUEST.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.
kit_api_refusal.API_DUPLICATE_REQUEST.fix: Read the first call's result with status.get.

kit_api_refusal.API_IDEMPOTENCY_UNVERIFI.what: The kit could not check whether this key was used before, so it did not risk a write.
kit_api_refusal.API_IDEMPOTENCY_UNVERIFI.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.

kit_api_refusal.API_REF_NOT_DEFAULT_BRAN.what: A ticket or deploy call was dispatched on a branch other than the default branch.
kit_api_refusal.API_REF_NOT_DEFAULT_BRAN.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.

kit_api_refusal.API_TRANSPORT_NOT_PERMIT.what: A release was requested by repository_dispatch, which the API does not accept for releases.
kit_api_refusal.API_TRANSPORT_NOT_PERMIT.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.

kit_api_refusal.API_REPOSITORY_NOT_SERVE.what: The request names another repository; each API instance serves only its own.
kit_api_refusal.API_REPOSITORY_NOT_SERVE.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.

kit_api_refusal.API_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE.what: The named security run is not a completed default-branch run, or its evidence has expired.
kit_api_refusal.API_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.
kit_api_refusal.API_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE.fix: Name a completed default-branch run within the artifact retention.

kit_api_refusal.API_FINDING_NOT_KIT_ESTA.what: A selected finding is not one the kit's scan established.
kit_api_refusal.API_FINDING_NOT_KIT_ESTA.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.

kit_api_refusal.API_DISPOSITION_NOT_VIA_.what: An exception, false positive or risk acceptance was requested through the API.
kit_api_refusal.API_DISPOSITION_NOT_VIA_.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.
kit_api_refusal.API_DISPOSITION_NOT_VIA_.fix: Open a pull request to the policy register; dispositions are merged under CODEOWNERS.

kit_api_refusal.API_TICKET_NOT_KIT_STAMP.what: The ticket does not carry the kit's stamp, so the kit does not own it.
kit_api_refusal.API_TICKET_NOT_KIT_STAMP.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.
kit_api_refusal.API_TICKET_NOT_KIT_STAMP.fix: Comment on it in the tracker directly.

kit_api_refusal.API_FILTER_NEEDS_FINDING.what: A CVE, KEV or text filter needs a findings run id.
kit_api_refusal.API_FILTER_NEEDS_FINDING.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.

kit_api_refusal.API_RELEASE_PATH_NOT_PER.what: Rollback and break-glass cannot be requested through the API.
kit_api_refusal.API_RELEASE_PATH_NOT_PER.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.
kit_api_refusal.API_RELEASE_PATH_NOT_PER.fix: A person dispatches the release workflow with the exception record.

kit_api_refusal.API_ENVIRONMENT_NOT_PERM.what: The environment is not in this repository's API deploy list, or a build was asked for uat/prod.
kit_api_refusal.API_ENVIRONMENT_NOT_PERM.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.
kit_api_refusal.API_ENVIRONMENT_NOT_PERM.fix: Use a listed environment (vars.KIT_API_DEPLOY_ENVIRONMENTS); reach uat and prod by promotion.

kit_api_refusal.API_PROMOTION_SOURCE_REQ.what: A promotion was requested without the run and environment to promote from.
kit_api_refusal.API_PROMOTION_SOURCE_REQ.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.

kit_api_refusal.API_DEPLOY_NEEDS_HUMAN_A.what: The target environment does not require a human approver with self-review prevented.
kit_api_refusal.API_DEPLOY_NEEDS_HUMAN_A.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.
kit_api_refusal.API_DEPLOY_NEEDS_HUMAN_A.fix: Protect the environment with required reviewers and prevent self-review.

kit_api_refusal.API_TEMPLATE_INVALID.what: A ticket template item is invalid; data.template_refusal names the rule.
kit_api_refusal.API_TEMPLATE_INVALID.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.
kit_api_refusal.API_TEMPLATE_INVALID.fix: Correct the named item; nothing was read or written.

kit_api_refusal.API_REVIEW_NOT_FINALIZED.what: The review behind the tickets is not finalized with a recorded second-person approval.
kit_api_refusal.API_REVIEW_NOT_FINALIZED.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.
kit_api_refusal.API_REVIEW_NOT_FINALIZED.fix: Have the concurring reviewer approve and merge the review record.

kit_api_refusal.API_TEMPLATE_RULE_REFUSE.what: A ticket rule that reads the tracker refused an item before anything was written.
kit_api_refusal.API_TEMPLATE_RULE_REFUSE.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.
kit_api_refusal.API_TEMPLATE_RULE_REFUSE.fix: Read data.template_refusal and correct the item.

kit_api_refusal.API_TRACKER_QUERY_REFUSE.what: A tracker query named a project outside this repository's, or a forbidden clause.
kit_api_refusal.API_TRACKER_QUERY_REFUSE.why: The API refuses by name before doing anything, so nothing changed.
kit_api_refusal.API_TRACKER_QUERY_REFUSE.fix: Query only this repository's projects, without ORDER BY.

oidc_subject_form.UNMATCHED.what: The identity GitHub presented does not match the federated credential's expected subject.
oidc_subject_form.UNMATCHED.why: Azure will refuse the sign-in (AADSTS700213); nothing was attempted.
oidc_subject_form.UNMATCHED.fix: Add a federated credential whose subject is exactly repo:<org>/<repo>:environment:<env> (case-sensitive), with this host's issuer.

authorization_probe_outcome.REACHED.what: The identity could act on a scope it should have been refused (its rights are wider than declared).
authorization_probe_outcome.REACHED.why: This is the loudest failure: the boundary does not hold.
authorization_probe_outcome.REACHED.fix: Ask the identity's owner to remove the role assignment on the scope the summary names.

authorization_probe_outcome.NOT_FOUND.what: A scope the check was told to probe does not exist.
authorization_probe_outcome.NOT_FOUND.why: It proves nothing about the identity's rights either way.
authorization_probe_outcome.NOT_FOUND.fix: Correct the scope id in the check's inputs.

authorization_probe_outcome.UNAVAILABLE.what: The access check never got an answer (throttling, network or an expired sign-in).
authorization_probe_outcome.UNAVAILABLE.why: Unknown is never treated as refused.
authorization_probe_outcome.UNAVAILABLE.fix: Re-run verify-azure-oidc.yml; check the runner's network if it repeats.

reusable_workflow_resolution.MISMATCHED.what: The workflow code that produced this evidence is not the code the caller said it expected.
reusable_workflow_resolution.MISMATCHED.why: A supply-chain mismatch: the kit pin or the caller is not what it claims.
reusable_workflow_resolution.MISMATCHED.fix: Check the uses: line pins the kit repository and SHA you intended.

external_findings_pull.SOURCE_NOT_CONFIG.what: A SonarQube or Aikido secret or setting is missing, so nothing was pulled.
external_findings_pull.SOURCE_NOT_CONFIG.fix: Set the SONAR_* or AIKIDO_* secrets the summary names.

external_findings_pull.SOURCE_AUTH_REFUS.what: SonarQube or Aikido refused the credentials (401/403).
external_findings_pull.SOURCE_AUTH_REFUS.why: Nothing was read; it is never "no findings".
external_findings_pull.SOURCE_AUTH_REFUS.fix: Renew the token and update the secret.

external_findings_pull.SOURCE_UNREACHABL.what: SonarQube or Aikido could not be reached or answered with an error.
external_findings_pull.SOURCE_UNREACHABL.fix: Re-run later; check the host secret and the runner's network.

external_findings_pull.SOURCE_RESPONSE_I.what: SonarQube or Aikido answered in an unexpected shape.
external_findings_pull.SOURCE_RESPONSE_I.why: The answer cannot be trusted as complete.
external_findings_pull.SOURCE_RESPONSE_I.fix: Check the host is the right product and version; report it to the platform team.

external_findings_pull.SOURCE_TRUNCATED.what: SonarQube or Aikido stopped returning pages before all findings were read.
external_findings_pull.SOURCE_TRUNCATED.why: A partial pull is never presented as complete.
external_findings_pull.SOURCE_TRUNCATED.fix: Narrow the project or raise the search depth; re-run.

external_findings_pull.SOURCE_HOST_REFUS.what: The SonarQube or Aikido host is not https, so no credential was sent.
external_findings_pull.SOURCE_HOST_REFUS.fix: Use the https URL of the service.

external_findings_pull.NOT_MAPPED.what: A pulled finding could not be turned into a kit finding (no repository, file or known severity).
external_findings_pull.NOT_MAPPED.why: It is listed with the reason, not dropped.
external_findings_pull.NOT_MAPPED.fix: Map the project to this repository, or triage the listed item by hand.

finding_id_form.CWE_FORM_UNKNOWN.what: A finding carries a weakness id (CWE) in a form the kit does not recognise.
finding_id_form.CWE_FORM_UNKNOWN.why: The kit never guesses an id; the finding is routed to a person.
finding_id_form.CWE_FORM_UNKNOWN.fix: Nothing for you; the platform team adds the form if it is valid.

finding_id_form.VULN_ID_FORM_UNKNOWN.what: A finding carries a vulnerability id the kit does not recognise (not CVE, GHSA or OSV).
finding_id_form.VULN_ID_FORM_UNKNOWN.why: The kit never guesses an id; the finding is routed to a person.
finding_id_form.VULN_ID_FORM_UNKNOWN.fix: Nothing for you; the platform team maps it in id-mappings.json.

unknown_id_review.NEEDS_MAPPING.what: An id the kit could not read is waiting for a person to map it.
unknown_id_review.NEEDS_MAPPING.why: The finding is still a finding; only its id is unmapped.
unknown_id_review.NEEDS_MAPPING.fix: The platform team maps it in id-mappings.json with a review reference.

unknown_id_review.MAPPING_NOT_REVIEWED.what: An id mapping has no author, date or review reference, so it was refused.
unknown_id_review.MAPPING_NOT_REVIEWED.why: Mappings change how findings are grouped; each must be reviewed.
unknown_id_review.MAPPING_NOT_REVIEWED.fix: Add author, date and review_ref to the mapping in id-mappings.json.

kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_STACK_UNKNOWN.what: kit init did not recognise any language or deploy type in this repository, so it wrote nothing.
kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_STACK_UNKNOWN.why: It never guesses a pipeline: a wrong one would scan the wrong things and look green.
kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_STACK_UNKNOWN.fix: Add the missing manifest (requirements.txt, package.json, pom.xml, go.mod, a .csproj, composer.json, a Dockerfile, *.tf or *.bicep), or copy templates/security.yml by hand.

kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_MULTIPLE_IMAGES.what: This repository has more than one Dockerfile and kit init will not pick which one deploys.
kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_MULTIPLE_IMAGES.why: Picking the wrong image would deploy the wrong thing.
kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_MULTIPLE_IMAGES.fix: Re-run with --dockerfile path/to/Dockerfile (in the workflow: re-run kit init locally with that flag).

kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_PIN_MISSING.what: kit init was not told which kit repository and commit to pin.
kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_PIN_MISSING.why: Every kit reference must be pinned to one exact commit.
kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_PIN_MISSING.fix: Pass --kit-repo OWNER/REPO and --kit-sha <40-hex commit>; the workflow wrapper takes both from its own uses: line.

kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_PIN_NOT_CHECKOUT.what: The commit you asked kit init to pin is not the kit commit it is running from.
kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_PIN_NOT_CHECKOUT.why: The files would describe one kit version and pin another.
kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_PIN_NOT_CHECKOUT.fix: Check out the kit at the commit you want (git checkout <sha>) and run again, or omit --kit-sha.

kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_HOST_UNSUPPORTED.what: The repository's host is neither github.com nor a <tenant>.ghe.com host.
kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_HOST_UNSUPPORTED.why: The kit supports only those two hosts.

kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_API_NEEDS_CONTAI.what: The kit API caller was requested, but this repository is not a container deploy.
kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_API_NEEDS_CONTAI.why: The API's release path calls build-deploy.yml, which exists only for container deploys.
kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_API_NEEDS_CONTAI.fix: Drop --with-api for now (scans and findings need no API).

kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_SECRET_REFUSED.what: kit init found a secret-looking value in what it was about to write, so it wrote nothing.
kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_SECRET_REFUSED.why: Generated files are committed; a secret in them would leak.
kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_SECRET_REFUSED.fix: Remove the secret from the path or variable the message names (and rotate it), then run again.

kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_GENERATED_INVALI.what: kit init's own check of the files it generated failed, so it wrote nothing.
kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_GENERATED_INVALI.why: This is a kit defect, not a problem with your repository.
kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_GENERATED_INVALI.fix: Send the output to the platform team; pin a different kit commit meanwhile.

kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_DIRTY_TREE.what: The repository has uncommitted changes, so kit init did not open its pull request.
kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_DIRTY_TREE.why: It commits only its own files, from a clean tree.
kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_DIRTY_TREE.fix: Commit or stash your changes and run again, or use --dry-run to write files only.

kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_PR_NOT_OPENED.what: kit init wrote the files but git or gh refused to push the branch or open the pull request.
kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_PR_NOT_OPENED.why: Nothing was lost; the files are in your working tree.
kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_PR_NOT_OPENED.fix: Check the token can push (Contents, Pull requests and Workflows: write) and GH_HOST is your host; then commit and open the PR yourself.

kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_HUMAN_EDIT_PRESE.what: kit init kept a file (or the CODEOWNERS block) exactly as a person left it, instead of updating it.
kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_HUMAN_EDIT_PRESE.why: A person's edit always wins; that file did not get the kit's newest version.
kit_init_state.KIT_INIT_HUMAN_EDIT_PRESE.fix: Nothing, if your edit is intended. To take the kit's version, delete the file (or the block's marker lines) and run kit init again.

dependabot_triage_rule.policy_misconfigu.what: The triage settings in the caller workflow are invalid, so every update goes to a person.
dependabot_triage_rule.policy_misconfigu.why: A broken policy must never auto-merge.
dependabot_triage_rule.policy_misconfigu.fix: Fix the triage inputs the comment names in .github/workflows/dependabot-triage.yml.

dependabot_triage_rule.excluded_path.what: This update touches a path excluded from updates (for example test fixtures), so it was closed.
dependabot_triage_rule.excluded_path.fix: If the path should take updates, remove it from excluded_paths.

dependabot_triage_rule.metadata_unverifi.what: The update's Dependabot metadata could not be verified.

dependabot_triage_rule.files_unknown.what: The list of files this update changes could not be read.
dependabot_triage_rule.files_unknown.why: Nobody can show it changes only dependencies.
dependabot_triage_rule.files_unknown.fix: Review the diff and merge it yourself.

dependabot_triage_rule.security_critical.what: This is a security update for a protected package.
dependabot_triage_rule.security_critical.why: Security updates to critical packages get a person first, urgently.
dependabot_triage_rule.security_critical.fix: Review it first and merge it today.

dependabot_triage_rule.critical_package.what: The package is on the protected list (runtime-critical).
dependabot_triage_rule.critical_package.why: Critical packages always get a person.
dependabot_triage_rule.critical_package.fix: Review the changelog and merge it yourself.

dependabot_triage_rule.critical_ecosyste.what: The update is in a protected ecosystem (docker, terraform, helm ...).
dependabot_triage_rule.critical_ecosyste.why: Infrastructure updates can change runtime behaviour.

dependabot_triage_rule.triage_chain.what: The update changes the triage workflow or the kit pin itself.
dependabot_triage_rule.triage_chain.why: An update must not decide its own merge.

dependabot_triage_rule.major_update.what: This is a major version update.
dependabot_triage_rule.major_update.fix: Read the release notes, test, and merge it yourself.

dependabot_triage_rule.update_type_unkno.what: The update type (major, minor, patch) could not be read.
dependabot_triage_rule.update_type_unkno.why: Unknown is never treated as safe.

dependabot_triage_rule.update_type_not_a.what: The update type is not one this repository auto-merges.
dependabot_triage_rule.update_type_not_a.why: Only allowed types merge on their own.

dependabot_triage_rule.actions_major_unk.what: A GitHub Actions update's version jump could not be read.
dependabot_triage_rule.actions_major_unk.why: Unknown is never treated as safe.

dependabot_triage_rule.actions_pin_not_s.what: A GitHub Actions update is not pinned to a full commit SHA.
dependabot_triage_rule.actions_pin_not_s.why: Actions must be pinned by SHA.
dependabot_triage_rule.actions_pin_not_s.fix: Pin the action by SHA in the PR, then merge.

dependabot_triage_rule.non_dependency_fi.what: The update changes a file that is not a manifest or lockfile.
dependabot_triage_rule.non_dependency_fi.fix: Review the extra file and merge it yourself.

dependabot_triage_rule.non_dependency_ch.what: The update changes something other than a dependency version.

dependabot_triage_rule.breaking_change_s.what: The release notes mention a breaking change.
dependabot_triage_rule.breaking_change_s.why: A breaking change needs a person.
dependabot_triage_rule.breaking_change_s.fix: Read the notes, test, and merge it yourself.

dependabot_triage_rule.maintainer_change.what: The package's maintainer changed since the last version.
dependabot_triage_rule.maintainer_change.why: A new maintainer is a supply-chain signal.
dependabot_triage_rule.maintainer_change.fix: Check the new maintainer and merge it yourself.

dependabot_triage_rule.lockfile_churn.what: The lockfile changes more lines than this repository auto-merges.
dependabot_triage_rule.lockfile_churn.why: Large lockfile changes can hide unrelated moves.
dependabot_triage_rule.lockfile_churn.fix: Review the lockfile diff and merge it yourself.

dependabot_triage_rule.lockfile_unparsed.what: The lockfile change could not be read package by package.
dependabot_triage_rule.lockfile_unparsed.why: Nobody can show only the named packages moved.
dependabot_triage_rule.lockfile_unparsed.fix: Review the lockfile diff and merge it yourself.

dependabot_triage_rule.lockfile_unrelate.what: The lockfile also changes packages this update does not name.
dependabot_triage_rule.lockfile_unrelate.why: Unrelated moves are not covered by the update.
dependabot_triage_rule.lockfile_unrelate.fix: Review the extra packages and merge it yourself.

dependabot_triage_rule.compatibility_unk.what: No compatibility score is available and this repository requires one.

dependabot_triage_rule.compatibility_low.what: The compatibility score is below this repository's minimum.
dependabot_triage_rule.compatibility_low.fix: Test it and merge it yourself.

dependabot_triage_rule.required_checks_u.what: The branch protection of the base branch could not be read.
dependabot_triage_rule.required_checks_u.why: Nobody can show the required checks would decide the merge.
dependabot_triage_rule.required_checks_u.fix: Give the triage token read access, or review and merge yourself.

dependabot_triage_rule.no_required_check.what: The base branch requires no status checks, so an auto-merge would merge untested code.
dependabot_triage_rule.no_required_check.why: Auto-merge is safe only behind required checks.

dependabot_triage_rule.scan_gate_unnamed.what: The triage caller names no required_checks.
dependabot_triage_rule.scan_gate_unnamed.why: Nothing shows the tests and scan decide the merge.
dependabot_triage_rule.scan_gate_unnamed.fix: Set required_checks in dependabot-triage.yml (for example "security / Security gate").

dependabot_triage_rule.scan_gate_not_req.what: A check the triage relies on is not required on the base branch.
dependabot_triage_rule.scan_gate_not_req.why: The merge would not wait for it.
dependabot_triage_rule.scan_gate_not_req.fix: Make the named check required in the branch ruleset.

ticket_template_refusal.CHILD_OBLIGATION.what: The multicloud ticket cannot close yet: a child obligation (Azure or AWS) is still open.
ticket_template_refusal.CHILD_OBLIGATION.why: Each cloud has its own owner and its own fix; the parent closes only when every child is verified.
ticket_template_refusal.CHILD_OBLIGATION.fix: Close each child ticket first (its owner resolves it; a rescan or another person verifies it); the parent then closes itself.

ticket_governance_state.CORRELATION_LABE.what: A ticket carries the finding's label but not its full key, so it was shown to a person instead of being linked.
ticket_governance_state.CORRELATION_LABE.why: A label is only a search aid; linking on it alone could attach the finding to the wrong ticket.
ticket_governance_state.CORRELATION_LABE.fix: Confirm the link in a finalized review (link_decisions); the kit then writes the full key into the ticket.

ticket_governance_state.CORRELATION_LABE.what: A ticket carries this finding's label but its full key belongs to a different finding.
ticket_governance_state.CORRELATION_LABE.why: The full key is the only identity; a shared short label is a search ambiguity, not a match.
ticket_governance_state.CORRELATION_LABE.fix: A person checks both tickets; nothing is merged unless a reviewer links them.

ticket_governance_state.PROVENANCE_MISMA.what: The integration named on the ticket (the via label) is not the identity that actually wrote it.
ticket_governance_state.PROVENANCE_MISMA.why: A via label is a claim; a mismatch can mean a misconfigured integration or a ticket made to look automated.
ticket_governance_state.PROVENANCE_MISMA.fix: Check KIT_INTEGRATION_IDENTITIES and who created the ticket; correct the mapping or investigate the ticket.

ticket_governance_state.PROVENANCE_NOT_E.what: The kit could not confirm who wrote the ticket.
ticket_governance_state.PROVENANCE_NOT_E.why: Without the authenticated identity and the tracker's write record, the via claim is unproven.
ticket_governance_state.PROVENANCE_NOT_E.fix: Give the tracker credential read access to the creator or activity history, and register the integration in KIT_INTEGRATION_IDENTITIES.

ticket_governance_state.AREA_UNRESOLVED.what: No routing rule gave this finding an owning area, so it waits in triage with an owner role and a deadline.
ticket_governance_state.AREA_UNRESOLVED.why: A finding nobody owns is not worked; the triage owner must place it before the deadline.
ticket_governance_state.AREA_UNRESOLVED.fix: The owner role adds a ticket_routing rule that covers this kind of finding (or records why it has none).

ticket_governance_state.AREA_UNRESOLVED_.what: A finding with no owning area is past its triage deadline.
ticket_governance_state.AREA_UNRESOLVED_.why: It is still unowned; every run reports it until it is routed.
ticket_governance_state.AREA_UNRESOLVED_.fix: Add a ticket_routing rule for it (the run names the owner role and the ticket).

ticket_governance_state.TAG_PRESERVATION.what: Freshservice replaced the ticket's whole tag list and the kit could not prove nobody else's tag change was lost.
ticket_governance_state.TAG_PRESERVATION.why: A person's tag may have been dropped by the kit's write.
ticket_governance_state.TAG_PRESERVATION.fix: Check the ticket's tags against its activity history (the kit left a private note saying so).

ticket_governance_state.TICKET_WRITE_LOC.what: Another kit writer was updating the same ticket, so this write waited and then stopped.
ticket_governance_state.TICKET_WRITE_LOC.why: Two writers on one Freshservice ticket can overwrite each other's tags.
ticket_governance_state.TICKET_WRITE_LOC.fix: Nothing to do; the next run makes the write. If it repeats, look for a stuck run.

ticket_governance_state.STAMP_FIELD_NOT_.what: The new Freshservice ticket's key field did not save the full key.
ticket_governance_state.STAMP_FIELD_NOT_.why: The key field is how the kit finds the ticket again; the description still carries the key.
ticket_governance_state.STAMP_FIELD_NOT_.fix: Check FRESHSERVICE_STAMP_FIELD is a single-line text field on the ticket form.
